question: If [ {3(6)/(7) ÷ frac{{54}}{7} - left{ {3 - ( {2(3)/(4) - (3)/(2)} )} right}} ] + A ÷ 4 = 0, then what is the value of A?
solution:
**Given:-**

[ {3(6)/(7) ÷ frac{{54}}{7} - left{ {3 - ( {2(3)/(4) - (3)/(2)} )} right}} ] + A ÷ 4 = 0

**Concept used:-** BODMAS 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13bc0065c96e715682af7c8a6dc1b4c567b7a2a89597cc68809a5ff942c7e421.png] 

**Calculation:**

** **The expression could be written as:

⇒ [ {3(6)/(7) ÷ frac{{54}}{7} - left{ {3 - ( {2(3)/(4) - (3)/(2)} )} right}} ]+(A)/(4)=0

Solving the expression of () small bracket, 

⇒ (11)/(4)-(3)/(2) = (5)/(4)

Now the expression has become, 

⇒[ {3(6)/(7) ÷ frac{{54}}{7} - left{ {3 - (5)/(4)} right}} ]+(A)/(4)=0

Solving** **the expression inside the curly braces {},

⇒ 3-(5)/(4)=(7)/(4)

The simplified expression is,

⇒left [3(6)/(7) div (54)/(7)- (7)/(4)]+(A)/(4)=0~

**Solving** expression of rectangular bracket,

⇒ 3(6)/(7) div (54)/(7)- (7)/(4) = (27)/(7) div (54)/(7)- (7)/(4)

⇒ (27)/(7) times (7)/(54)- (7)/(4) = (1)/(2)-(7)/(4)

⇒ (-5)/(4)

The expression is, 

⇒ (-5)/(4)+(A)/(4)=0

⇒ A = 5

**∴ The value of A is 5**.
